data.one_liner: Encode and decode Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) files to/from raw and GeoJSON formats.
data.what_it_does: The package parses .mvt/.pbf files into a raw vector tile structure and can convert features to GeoJSON. It also allows creating vector tiles from raw data and writing them as protobuf files.
use_when: You need to read or write Mapbox Vector Tiles in a Flutter/Dart app
You want to convert vector tile features to GeoJSON for further processing
avoid_when: You require encoding from GeoJSON directly (not yet supported)
You need high‑level map rendering widgets (this package only handles data)
strengths: Supports both decoding and encoding of raw vector tiles
Works on all major platforms including web and desktop
weaknesses: Limited to raw tile manipulation, no map UI integration
